identificationModule.briefTitle: A Study of Raltitrexed Plus Docetaxel Versus Docetaxel as Second-line Chemotherapy in Subjects With Gastric Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Study of Raltitrexed Plus Docetaxel Versus Docetaxel as Second-line Chemotherapy in Subjects With Gastric Cancer

descriptionModule.briefSummary: A study of Raltitrexed plus Docetaxel versus Docetaxel as second-line chemotherapy in subjects with Gastric Cancer.The purpose of this study is to compare the activity of Raltitrexed plus Docetaxel versus Docetaxel as second-line chemotherapy in subjects with gastric carcinoma by estimating progression free survival (PFS) in each treatment arm.

interventions.name: Raltitrexed plus Docetaxel
interventions.description:

1; Docetaxel 75mg/m2 d1, every 3 weeks, 4-6 cycles)
